svg.title: Puffkin Pasture — Puffkin feeding barn
svg.desc: A feeding barn looks over three grazing paddocks. Hay bales, water troughs and fence posts build a gentle loop for the aid escort. Editable design layers: architecture, walkable ledges, supported climbs, jumpable props, numbered exits and NPCs.
svg.text: Shared access · None hostile; aid creature 1–5

g.text: Climbable stairs / ladders / ropes · pale edges are landable
Solid route stays open · furniture tops add optional hops

svg.text: A feeding barn looks over three grazing paddocks. Hay bales, water troughs and fence posts
build a gentle loop for the aid escort.
6 raised landings · 2 stairs · 2 ropes · 2 ladders · 22 props
R = same-map recovery · structural concept, not an exported collision mesh
Encounter: Meadow Puffkin · Benevolent / Common; aid / escort / protection, never a kill-farm target.
